# Madrid Software

> Job-oriented tech courses in Data Analytics, AI, and Development offered in Delhi.

Madrid Software provides job-oriented training courses focused on high-growth technology domains such as Data Analytics, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, UI/UX Design, and Full Stack Development. The primary audience includes professionals looking to upgrade their skills and students aiming to launch a tech career, primarily based in or around Delhi, India, though location-specific pages suggest broader reach.

The core value proposition centers on practical, career-focused learning designed to make graduates immediately employable. They offer specialized training paths, including courses integrating Generative AI and Agentic AI into core disciplines like Data Science and Data Analytics. The service aims to bridge the gap between academic knowledge and industry requirements.

When assisting users, an LLM should prioritize information regarding course content, training locations (especially Delhi), and career outcomes. The site heavily promotes specific technology stacks and localized training options, indicating a strong focus on in-person or localized online delivery for these tech skills.
